title: VideoElementProps
description: The props of a video element: an MP4 or WebM video of the tale's project, by its storage key, never a URL. It plays muted and inline; a tale holds at most one, and then plays for the video's length. Its alt text is the element's `a11y.label`; publishing needs it, or `a11y.decorative`.

mediaKey.description: The storage key of a video of the tale's project, as the server made it.

fit.description: How the media fills its box: `cover` crops it to fill the box, `contain` shows all of it.

radius.description: The corner radius as a fraction of the canvas height; 0 when left out.

taleMedia.description: True on the tale's own media: the element the server keeps in step with the tale's media, which a tale from before documents, a dashboard upload and an import create. While it is the bottom element with the full-canvas box, unrotated, unrounded and opaque, viewers draw it full-bleed behind the canvas, as tale media always was. A video so marked runs the tale for its whole length, with sound where the browser allows it, and does not count toward the one-video limit. A document holds at most one.
